review_type: Independent source-first omission audit; source 03 bounded guideline review

deciding_originals: docs/text/TC/03.txt: corresponding selected passages and settled bilingual conditions
comparison: Part 1 existing sanctions/PF/TF material and Part 3 definitions checked as cross-references
scope.method: Read substantive original requirements, lists, conditions and footnotes, then compare concepts against source-authored manuscript prose and recall panels. The question bank was not used to supply copy or determine completeness. Anchor strings identify deciding passages; textual matching is not semantic validation.
limitations: This is a focused semantic gap audit of source 03, not a legal opinion or certification that every statement in all 01–26 publications is covered.
No comprehensive re-review of unchanged Part 1–4 statutory/licensing prose; parent and another reviewer handle those sources.
Draft essentials.py is being integrated concurrently. Findings describe the snapshot bound below; later integration/resolution requires read-back.
Non-exhaustive illustrative source lists need not be reproduced verbatim; findings prioritize distinct concepts, qualifications, actors and operative requirements.
Publication edition and settled language differences are retained; no live legal update or outside research performed.

findings.manuscript_target: part6.py / monitoring / 持續CDD及交易監察

source.deciding_anchor: an MSO should conduct a review upon reactivation of the relationship

findings.observed_coverage: Current English says dormant relationships MAY be reviewed on reactivation; TC 可待 likewise does not state the required reactivation review. Regular dormant review need not be done; defining dormancy in policy is absent.

recommended_substance.tc: 休眠客戶不必定期覆核現有CDD紀錄，但關係重新啟用時須覆核；政策及程序須清楚界定何謂休眠客戶。
recommended_substance.en: Regular review of dormant CDD records is unnecessary, but review is required upon relationship reactivation. Policies/procedures should clearly define a dormant customer.

An appropriate register needs adequate transparency and current ownership/control data; professional trustee means trust administration/management as a profession or business.

source.deciding_anchor: should endeavour to obtain the same identification information as at paragraph [4.3.2] as far as possible

recommended_substance.tc: 識別實益擁有人時，應盡量設法取得姓名、出生日期、國籍、唯一識別號碼及證件類型。核實程度須合理及按風險；在極低風險情況（如慈善信託），可合理地以客戶提供資料（包括已核實受託人）及確認其認識該實益擁有人來確認身分；不是所有慈善團體一律豁免。

Exceptionally low risk, such as a charitable trust, may justify confirmation using customer-provided information, including verified trustees, and confirmation the BO is known to the customer. This is not an automatic charity exemption.

findings.manuscript_target: part1.py / legal-framework and part6.py / screening

source.deciding_anchor: section 11L prohibits any person from providing or collecting any property to

findings.observed_coverage: General TF intent/knowledge/recklessness and actual-use distinction are covered. Distinct specified-terrorist-property dealing and inter-state terrorist-travel offences are not stated in sufficient concrete terms.

recommended_substance.tc: 第8A條禁止明知或罔顧財產是否指明恐怖分子財產／指明恐怖分子或其有聯繫者財產而處理。第11L條禁止提供／籌集財產資助跨國旅行，意圖或明知旅行為實施、計劃、準備、參與恐怖行為或相關訓練；即使沒有實際恐怖行為亦適用。
recommended_substance.en: Section 8A prohibits dealing knowing or reckless as to whether property is specified terrorist property or property of a specified terrorist/associate. Section 11L prohibits providing/collecting property for inter-state travel intending or knowing the specified terrorist-act or related-training purpose; an actual terrorist act need not occur.

findings.manuscript_target: part6.py / suspicion-indicators

source.deciding_anchor: “Structuring” or “Smurfing”

findings.observed_coverage: Strong TBML categories already exist. Other red flags are reduced to two broad points, omitting the named U-turn concept and distinctive agent/behaviour categories. Do not duplicate the full TBML list.

recommended_substance.tc: 分拆／化整為零（Structuring／Smurfing）是本可用一／幾宗大額交易而改用多宗小額；U-turn是境外來源款項又匯往同一境外地另一人／公司，或原發款人在另一地的戶口。另記小鈔換大鈔、代理拒交識別資料／同一客戶資料拼寫或局部逐漸變動、同日多代理分流、低調陪同者／催促先交易後補文件／不理費率，以及衝突區慈善捐款。指標非窮盡，也不是單項定罪或一律須報STR；任何相關指標應促進一步調查、初步資金來源查詢及支持文件。
recommended_substance.en: Structuring/smurfing uses many lower-value transactions where one/few large ones could be used. A U-turn sends foreign-origin funds back to another person/company in the same foreign jurisdiction or the sender’s account elsewhere. Also recall denomination changes; agent ID refusal/evolving spellings or partial identity details/same-day routing to multiple agents; discreet companions/rushing with later documentation/no concern for rates; and conflict-zone charity donations. Indicators are non-exhaustive and not automatic proof or mandatory STR in every case; a relevant flag prompts further investigation, initial source-of-funds enquiries and supporting evidence.

recommended_substance.tc: 公司註冊證書本身不是現時存在證明；公司登記查冊應取得完整公司查冊報告。核證人須簽署、日期、職位／身分、原件真確副本聲明，並在簽署下以大寫清晰列印姓名。附錄註明年滿11歲香港居民須登記領取HKID，永久居民HKID出生日期下有A字；這些是本版附錄的文件辨認細節。
